decisions: Order button: Law of Ukraine No. 3153-IX “Про захист прав споживачів” (2023), Art. 19, requires the order button to say “замовлення з оплатою” or equivalent unambiguous wording — but the law enters into force only after martial law ends (check status at launch). Recommend using “Замовлення з оплатою” now anyway (card variant “Сплатити {amount}”); the verbatim article text could not be fetched, so a lawyer should confirm.

Pay at Hatch: recommend “Оплата у фудтраку” (feature) / “Оплата на місці” (button). Avoid “оплата при отриманні” and “накладений платіж” — both read as Nova Poshta cash-on-delivery; Delivety already uses “оплату готівкою при отриманні” in a courier context.
Apostrophe inside words: U+2019 (м’ясо, кав’ярня, п’ятниця, обов’язково), never a straight apostrophe (U+0027) and never U+02BC — pick once for all parts.

Messenger: Telegram and Viber are generally reported as Ukraine’s main messengers (general knowledge, not re-checked here); WhatsApp auto-replies are less of a headline feature for UA than in WhatsApp-first markets.
Russian-Federation brands, ₽ and Russian-language search results must not leak into UA copy; currency is гривня (₴ / грн).
